chunks: Washing the head with al-khiṭmī every Jumu‘ah is protection from vitiligo and insanity.

key_terms.بِالْخِطْمِيِّ: with al-khiṭmī, a cleansing herbal plant

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about washing the head with al-khiṭmī on Jumu‘ah?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes a protective benefit to washing the head with al-khiṭmī every Jumu‘ah. It reflects the Islamic emphasis on cleanliness, regular grooming, and beneficial practices associated with the blessed day of Friday.
